discription: A versatile filtered saw wave synth with ADSR envelope, featuring adjustable low-pass filter cutoff and resonance.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=2000, rq=0.5;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.05, 0.3, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = Saw.ar(freq);sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq);sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
